## NYT::NFlow::TUnitedParameters&lt;NYT::NFlow::TProcessFunctionStaticTableExportSink&gt; {#NYT_NFlow_TUnitedParameters_NYT_NFlow_TProcessFunctionStaticTableExportSink}

Source: [yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/registry-inl.h]({{source-root}}/yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/registry-inl.h)

#|
|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `output_directory` | **Type**: `NYT::NYPath::TRichYPath`
**Required parameter**
Directory of the published tables. Export state is kept in its `_export_state` child. ||
|| `window_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `5m`
Window length, a whole number of seconds. A message goes to the window of its source write time. ||
|| `closure_delta` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `30s`
Extra delay after the window end before the window may close. Must be less than two window periods. ||
|| `compression_codec` | **Type**: [NYT::NCompression::ECodec](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NCompression_ECodec)
**Default value**: `zstd_4`
Compression codec of the published tables. ||
|| `optimize_for` | **Type**: [NYT::NTableClient::EOptimizeFor](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NTableClient_EOptimizeFor)
**Default value**: `scan`
`optimize_for` of the published tables. ||
|| `max_unpublished_window_count` | **Type**: `int`
**Default value**: `16`
Number of windows after the last published one that writers may append to. Bounds unpublished data when publication stalls. Must satisfy `max_unpublished_window_count * window_period > drift_bound + closure_delta + 3 * window_period`, where `drift_bound` is the watermark alignment drift bound. ||
|| `writer_resource_id` | **Type**: [NYT::NFlow::TResourceId](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NFlow_TResourceId)
**Required parameter**
Id of the `NYT::NFlow::TStaticTableExportWriterResource` that writes the tables; the resource must be required on workers only. ||
|| `table_name_utc_offset` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `+03:00`
Offset from UTC of the civil time used to name published tables after the window start, like `+03:00`. A region time zone is not accepted: a daylight saving shift would give two windows one name. ||
|| `schema` | **Type**: `NYT::TIntrusivePtr<NYT::NTableClient::TTableSchema>`
**Required parameter**
Schema of the exported tables. Without `processing_function`, the columns are taken from the source row by name; system columns and sorting are not allowed. ||
|| `processing_function` | **Type**: `std::optional<std::string>`
Name of the per-message process function that turns a source row into table rows. The function cannot use state, timers, watermarks or throttlers; `GetCurrentTimestamp` returns the wall-clock time. ||
|| `processing_function_parameters` | **Type**: `NYT::TIntrusivePtr<NYT::NYTree::IMapNode>`
Static parameters of `processing_function`. ||
